title.narrative: Improved Livelihood in Northeast Albania Phase Out

description.narrative: The project is subject to phase out. Announced in July 2025, the phase out period is ending on March 31st 2026. The objective of the phase out period is to support AgroPuka in securinglong-term availability of the services and viability of AgroPuka. It supports their resource mobilization efforts to sustain service delivery, facilitates the potential transfer of services to another PO or emerging organisation, and reinforces continuity and local ownership throughout the transition. The project will supprot development of the new organisatinal strategy 2026-2030, revision of the gender policy, and implement actions that will oincrease the organisational visibility. Along the activities that support their sustainability, the phase out also considers specific actions contributing to improvedlivelihood in the rural communities of the Northeast Albania, including revision of the climate adaptation plan for two municipalities, and support the local climate coalitionestablished during the previous programme period.
